newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - June 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - June 27.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Friday:

* The U.S. Supreme Court has unanimously upheld state laws that prohibit doctor-assisted suicide, but suggested it may be willing to remain open to constitutional claims for assistance by the terminally ill in the future.
* The court's decision on assisted suicide, a growing moral issue in the United States, does little to settle the matter for Americans worried about how they will die in such cases.
* The U.S. Supreme Court has declared as unconstitutional a federal law that bans "indecent" material on the Internet.
* U.S. President Bill Clinton sent out a warning on the dangers of global warming but he fell short of offering the commitment to reduce greenhouse gases that allies have urged.
* The U.S. House of Representatives passed a tax-cut package that offers everything from a $500 per child credit for many families to reductions in capital gains.
* News Corp Ltd's publishing house, HarperCollins, has scaled back on its book lists in a cost-cutting measures.
* Congolese troops detained a top opposition leader, signaling a hard line against dissenters.
